description.en: 8 cars from Forza Motorsport 6, converted by ZephyrSkies: 1987 Porsche #17 Porsche AG 962C; 1988 Jaguar #60 Castrol Jaguar Racing XJR-9; 1991 Mazda #18 Mazdaspeed 787B; 1991 Nissan #23 Nissan R91CP; 1993 Peugeot #3 Peugeot Talbot Sport 905 EVO 1C; 1998 Ferrari #30 MOMO Doran Racing F333 SP; 1999 BMW #15 BMW Motorsport V12 LMR; 1999 BMW #16 BMW Motorsport V12 LMR. Needs ZS FM6 Common. Online, everyone in a lobby needs the same packs.

description.en: Hold RT in the garage to hear the car's engine rev. From Extra Options by Arthur (RokkuDayo), built from its source. Garage only: nothing other players see, hear or race against, so it plays in every mode.

description.en: Time and weather in the free-roam pause menu: press Y to lock the hour and pick sunny, wet, rain or storm. From Extra Options, built from its source. It changes the world you race in, so it plays in Noob only.
description.pt-BR: Hora e clima no menu de pausa do free roam: aperte Y para travar a hora e escolher sol, pista molhada, chuva ou tempestade. Do Extra Options, compilado a partir do código-fonte. Muda o mundo em que você corre, então funciona só no Noob.

description.en: Plays Spotify on the game's own Xbox Music station, in the car, at car meets and from the festival speakers, with the song on the radio HUD. Needs Spotify Premium: in Spotify, pick the speaker "Forza Horizon Radio". The first start opens Spotify's sign-in page in your browser. Left stick or F6 skips, F5 goes back, F7 pauses. By Bullet4fun, built from its source as an ExtraOptions mod. Only you hear it: it plays in every mode.
description.pt-BR: Toca o Spotify na própria estação Xbox Music do jogo, no carro, nos encontros de carros e nos alto-falantes do festival, com a música no HUD do rádio. Precisa do Spotify Premium: no Spotify, escolha o alto-falante "Forza Horizon Radio". Na primeira vez, a página de login do Spotify abre no navegador. Analógico esquerdo ou F6 pula, F5 volta, F7 pausa. De Bullet4fun, compilado a partir do código-fonte como mod do ExtraOptions. Só você ouve: funciona em todos os modos.

install.license: GPL-3.0-or-later

description.en: Extra cameras by Deuquan: drone and free cam (O), walk mode (P), follow drone (T), passenger (M), driver seat (H), 360 (X), roof, dashcam, dashboard and front chase cams (1-4), cinema mode and an enhanced chase cam; LB cycles them on a controller. Built from its source. Keys are fixed to the defaults. A free camera shows more of a race than the game's own, so it plays in Noob only.
description.pt-BR: Câmeras extras de Deuquan: drone e câmera livre (O), modo a pé (P), drone que segue o carro (T), passageiro (M), banco do motorista (H), 360 (X), câmeras de teto, painel, retrovisor e perseguição frontal (1-4), modo cinema e uma câmera de perseguição aprimorada; no controle, LB alterna entre elas. Compilado a partir do código-fonte. As teclas são as padrão. Uma câmera livre mostra mais de uma corrida do que as do próprio jogo, então funciona só no Noob.

install.license: GPL-3.0
